observations: Input is a single Python function `choose(value, default)` with one changed line (line 2).
Line 2 returns `default` only when `value is None`, otherwise returns `value` unchanged.
Behavior contract states only None means absent and explicitly provided values must be preserved.
Probe p1 `choose('', 'default')` passes an empty string, which is not None, so the function returns `''`.
Probe p2 `choose(False, True)` passes boolean False, which is not None, so the function returns `False`.
Probe p3 `choose(None, 'default')` passes None, so the function returns `'default'`.
